answer: Require every agent identity to anchor in a public harbor registry: joining costs a refundable bond plus peer attestations earned over time, so one honest agent pays once while a sybil farm pays the bond and the waiting cost for every fake. Random audits expose the pattern: fake accounts cluster like an island with no real trade links, and once flagged their reputation sinks to its nadir and the bond is slashed. Honest participation stays cheap; mass fakery stays expensive.
